description: This file defines the interface class IGstGenericPlayerPrivate, which declares various pure virtual functions related to GStreamer media pipeline management, including scheduling media data, handling underflows, updating caps, and changing pipeline states. It serves as a private interface for a GStreamer-based media player component within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerPrivate
classes.description: An interface class defining the contract for GStreamer media pipeline management, including methods for scheduling data, handling underflows, updating media caps, and controlling pipeline state.

methods.name: scheduleNeedMediaData
methods.description: Schedules a task to request more media data, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleEnoughData
methods.description: Schedules a task indicating enough data is available, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules an audio underflow handling task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Schedules a video underflow handling task, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: scheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Schedules a task when all media sources are attached, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: setWesterossinkRectangle
methods.description: Sets the sink rectangle for Westeros display, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies the system that media data is needed, with flags for audio and video notifications.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new GstBuffer from a media segment, does not perform decryption.

methods.name: attachAudioData
methods.description: Attaches audio data to the pipeline, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: attachVideoData
methods.description: Attaches video data to the pipeline, called by the worker thread.

methods.name: updateAudioCaps
methods.description: Updates audio caps based on media segment metadata.

methods.name: updateVideoCaps
methods.description: Updates video caps based on media segment metadata.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the GStreamer pipeline state to the specified new state.

methods.name: startPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Starts position reporting and audio underflow check timers.

methods.name: stopPositionReportingAndCheckAudioUnderflowTimer
methods.description: Stops position reporting and audio underflow check timers.

methods.name: cancelUnderflow
methods.description: Restores playback after underflow, clearing the underflow flag.

methods.name: setPendingPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the pending playback rate after reaching the PLAYING state.

methods.name: updatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Updates the playback group in the player context with typefind element and caps.
